nota: Words of this language that look borrowed from another language but do not exist there with that meaning, grouped by the language they imitate.

parole.testo: Borrowed from English box. The "boxing" and "cabin" senses are a pseudo-anglicism, the "boxing" sense from English boxing, and the "cabin" sense from English box.
Pseudo-anglicism, derived from cross country. -cross exists in English to refer to cross country, but only as a suffix.
Pseudo-Latinism, borrowed from German Frisur, from French frisure, with ending Latinized based on Latin -ūra.
